label: Wielenberg positive making: token explanation and responsibility selection
summary: Complete revised analyst draft for parent independent challenge in docs/notes/wielenberg-making-account.md. Necessary substantive norms plus accurate natural facts conditionally entail token status and supply candidate explanation under an instantiation account; direction/relevance and the explanatory objection remain OPEN. Supervenience controls vary moral assignments without holding a substantive norm fixed, not countermodels of the positive package. Named biological-relative, undertaken-care and stranger trials separate descriptive facts from normative responsibility. Explicit R/N/T additions each yield a conditional pro-tanto reliance duty; care-to-rescue applicability remains OPEN, and priority still requires a separate conflict rule. The urgency comparison assumes explicitly that the threatened interest lies within undertaken care under every package. Defeasible and protected-duty completions remain rivals, with warrant open. Strongest rival permits fundamental necessary norms as explanatory termini. No attribution, new theorem, rival defeat, warrant certification or root discharge; moral-order-to-God bridge missing. The #1812 continuation (2026-11-24) fixes one actual patient and distinguishes the traced material, the capacity exercised and the adult with an undertaken duty. Replacing the isotope while preserving use of iron leaves the functional good intact. Exchanging undertakings changes the special duty under the responsibility premise. A mass ledger cannot identify an underived source of that capacity. See docs/notes/wielenberg-making-account.md#does-a-childs-actual-nourishment-identify-its-underived-source-1812 for the measurement, selected-cone application, impersonal completion and proposed assessment for challenge.
blocker: Independent semantic challenge accepted the prior repairs and required an explicit care-to-rescue scope qualification, now recorded. Next test: hold reliance and urgency fixed while varying entrusted-interest harm versus an unrelated emergency; establish each package's rescue reason before comparing priority. Then defend voluntarily induced reliance-to-duty against uninvited/unreasonable reliance and habitual care without assurances, then justify an urgency defeater independently of the desired verdict. No defended principle here selects those conditions. Historical making fidelity unverified; PDF request returned 403. For #1812, granting an underived ancestor of this child still leaves its contribution to the organizing activity in dispute. Trace that same source through maintenance of the specific capacity across material renewal. An existential ground or a measured nutrient input alone fails this test. Even local capacity-source credit leaves common causation, exemplary authorship, jurisdiction and GOD_4 identification open.
